name: Why hire a full-service remodeling contractor instead of just a drywall installer for storm repairs?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a full-service remodeling contractor instead of just a drywall installer for storm repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A remodeling general contractor coordinates the complete structural and cosmetic rebuild under one roof, whereas a dedicated drywall hanger only installs sheetrock. Storm restoration often involves wet insulation removal, wood framing inspection, subfloor checks, trim replacement, and whole-room painting. Hiring a contractor with finish carpentry and remodeling capabilities ensures you do not have to manage separate trades for drywall, baseboards, electrical adjustments, and painting, avoiding gaps in project scheduling and finish quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full-service remodeler handles framing, insulation, drywall, baseboard trim, and painting together, preventing trade coordination delays and incomplete repairs.
